items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I learned to play by music when I went to work with Max Fink at the Lill Club... I went to uh Memphis Tennessee with Max Fink

ctx.x: Well where did you learn to play the notes?

I learned to play by music when I went to work with Max Fink at the Lill Club. Oh. On the barone between St. Joseph and Julia. Max Fink used to pair everything from cover to cover you know. And I was playing sousaphone and I had to get the parts out because he didn't want anybody to know that I was the only faker in the band. So I'd get the parts out for every tune and I noticed that when I started it at this cover and I'd finish up with that cover every time I'd hit one particular note it would be on this…

That's an article here I noticed. It's a column called Know Your Coast. It's from the Biloxi paper. Monday afternoon, December the 29th, 1958. Yeah. So that picture with Johnny Bertuzzi was taken in January of 1920.
